meaningZh: 岛屿，因此 isolate 的含义为使孤立、隔离（即使岛屿孤立）

words.definition: （使）孤立，隔离；将……剔出（以便看清和单独处
examples:
That disturbs our personal lives, disrupts our sleeping and eating habits,
and isolates us from everything except job-related friends and activities.
那打扰了我们的个人生活，扰乱了我们的吃，睡习惯，使我们和除了
工作有关的朋友和活动孤立开。
words.mnemonic: isol-（=isle：岛）+ -ate（使动词后缀）→使成孤岛→使孤立；隔离

collocations: become increasingly isolated：变得越来越孤立
geographical isolation：地理上的隔离
an isolation hospital/ward：隔离医院/病房
feelings of isolation：孤独的感觉
in isolation (from sb./sth.)：单独地；孤立地
words.definition: 隔离，隔离状态；孤独，孤立状态
examples:
To make sense, these figures should not be looked at in isolation.
这些数据不应孤立起来看，否则就没有意义。
words.mnemonic: isol-(=isle：岛) + -ation（名词后缀）→向岛屿一样隔离、孤立→隔

collocations: an isolationist foreign policy：孤立主义外交政策
the perils of isolationism：孤立主义的危险
words.definition: 孤立主义者 adj. 孤立主义的
words.etymology: kae-id- *kaə-id-, Proto-Indo-European root meaning “to strike.” It is the hypothetical source of/evidence for its existence is provided by: Sanskrit skhidati “beats, tears;” Latin caedere “to strike down, fell, slay;” Lithuanian kaišti “shave;” Armenian xait’em “to stab;” Albanian qeth “to shave;” Middle Dutch heien “to drive piles,” Old High German heia “wooden hammer,” German heien “beat.”
words.mnemonic: isolation（孤立）+ -ist（名词/形容词后缀，表……主义者（的））→

collocations: precise details/instructions：确切的细节；明确的指令
at that precise moment：恰好在这个时候
precise worker：认真的工人
to be more precise：确切地说；准确地说
words.definition: 确切的，精确的；（强调时间或方式等）就，恰好；细致的，精细的，认真的，一丝不苟的
examples:
She’s rather prim and precise.
她拘谨严肃，一丝不苟。
words.mnemonic: pre-（预先）+ -cis-（=to cut：剪；切）+ -e →预先裁剪过的→确切

examples:
The first bell rang at precisely 10:29 a.m.
第一遍铃声在上午10：29准时响起。
Children come to zoos precisely to see captive animals.
孩子们到动物园来正是为了看那些被关起来的动物。

collocations: precision instruments/tools：精密仪器/工具
done with mathematical precision：以数学般的精确完成的
examples:
He chose his words with precision.
他用词确切。
words.mnemonic: precis（=precise：精确的；细致的）+ -ion（名词后缀）→精确；准

collocations: a concise summary 简明扼要的总结
clear concise instructions：言简意赅的说明
a concise dictionary：简明词典
words.mnemonic: con（加强语气）+ -cis-（=cut：切割，削减）+ e→削减之后→精简

collocations: the rise in excise duties：消费税的提高
an excise tax on wine and tobacco：烟酒的消费税
excised goods：征税商品
excised tissue：切除的组织
words.definition: 切除（器官、组织或部位等） n. 消费税；国内货物税
words.mnemonic: ex-（=out）+ -cis-（=to cut：减少；删节）+ e→to cut out：切除；删

ex-（=out）+ -cis-（=to cut：减少；删节）+ -ion（名词后缀）→to
cut out：切除；删除；切除物

collocations: decide their destiny：决定他们的命运
decide her sentence：裁定她的判决
decide between A and B/decide against sth.：在A与B之间决定；对……
words.definition: &vi. 决定；影响（或决定）……的结果 vt. 裁定；判决~
examples:
They decided against taking legal action.
他们决定不提起诉讼。
We’re still trying to decide on a venue.
我们仍然在设法选定一个会场。
words.mnemonic:
de-（=off：离开）+ -cid-（=to cut：切）+ -e →作决定就是“切去”
不需要的部分→决定；裁定；判决；断定

collocations: decisive victory：决定性胜利
decisive factor：决定性因素
decisive leader：果断的领导者
words.mnemonic:
de-（=off）+ -cis-（=to cut：切）+ -ive（形容词后缀）→切去的，一
刀两断的→决定性的；果断的

examples:
The plan was decisively rejected by Congress three weeks ago.
这个计划三周前被国会决定性地否决了。

words.definition: 未拿定主意的，犹豫不决的；尚未被确定的，
examples:
After college she was still undecided as to what career she wanted to
pursue.
大学毕业后她仍无法决定自己要追求什么事业。
The venue for the World Cup remains undecided.
世界杯的举办地点尚未确定。
words.mnemonic: un-（=not：不；未）+ decided（决定的）→未决定的→犹豫不决

collocations: decidedly uncomfortable：明显不舒服
say decidedly：果断地说
words.definition: 确切，肯定，显然；果断地，坚决地，坚定地
examples:
Amy was looking decidedly worried.
埃米看上去显然是忧心忡忡。

collocations: the deciding factor：决定性因素
make the wrong decision：做出错误的决定
the moment of decision：作决定的时刻
a man of decision：很果断的人
words.mnemonic: de-（离开）+ -cis-（切）+ -ion（名词后缀）→切断，与……分离→

collocations: Russia’s key decision-maker：俄罗斯的关键决策者
words.mnemonic: decision（决定）+ maker（制造人）→作决策的人→决策人

collocations: decision-making power：决策权
decision-making process：决策程序
words.mnemonic: decision（决定）+ making（做）→做决定→决策

examples:
After months of indecision, the government gave the plan the go-ahead on
Monday.
经过几个月的犹豫不决，政府在周一批准了这项计划。
words.mnemonic: in-（=not：不）+ decision（决定）→没有决定→优柔寡断；犹豫不决

words.definition: 割口；（尤指手术的）切口；切开
examples:
The technique involves making a tiny incision in the skin.
该技术需要在皮肤上切个小口。
words.mnemonic:
in-（进入；向内）+ -cis-（=to cut：切）+ -ion（名词后缀）→向内切
→切口；切开

collocations: commit suicide：自杀
a case of attempted suicide：一个自杀未遂的案子
political suicide：自毁政治前程
words.definition: 自杀；自毁；自取灭亡的行为
words.mnemonic: sui（=of oneself：自己）+ -cid-（杀）+ e→把自己割了→自杀

collocations: suicidal tendencies：自杀倾向
words.definition: 有自杀倾向的；有致命危险的，毁灭性的；灾难性
examples:
It would be suicidal to risk going out in this weather.
在这种天气冒险出去，真是不要命了。
The new economic policies could prove suicidal for the party.
新经济政策可能给该党带来灾难性的后果。
words.mnemonic: suicide（自杀）+ -al（形容词后缀）→有自杀倾向的→有致命危险

examples:
The police arrived at the scene of the homicide.
警察赶到了杀人现场。
words.mnemonic: homi-（=homo-：人）+ -cid-（杀）+ e→杀人；（蓄意）杀人罪

collocations: vegetables grown without the use of pesticides：未用杀虫剂种植的蔬菜
crops sprayed with pesticide：喷洒过杀虫剂的庄稼
words.mnemonic: pest（害虫）+ i+ -cide（=killer：致命的事物）→除灭害虫的东西→
herb-（草）+ i+ -cide（=killer：致命的事物）→除灭草的东西→除草剂
